clips.title: 欧洲热浪破纪录 学校关闭交通中断 电力供应承压

subtitles.en: Joe, I don't know how you've got a jacket on, first of all. I'm already hot this morning, but...
subtitles.zh: 乔，首先我不明白你怎么还穿着夹克。我今天早上已经很热了，但是……

subtitles.en: It's hot. Yeah, it's hot. There are a lot of questionable outfit choices out there.
subtitles.zh: 确实很热。外面有很多可疑的着装选择。

subtitles.en: Short, so I have already spotted in the office as well. In the office already, shorts?
subtitles.zh: 短裤，我已经在办公室看到了。办公室里已经有人穿短裤了？

subtitles.en: Indeed, not naming names, but look, this is a serious subject, right?
subtitles.zh: 确实，不点名了，但这是个严肃的话题，对吧？

subtitles.en: Sure. Because we've got travel disruption, we've got schools being closed. That's right.
subtitles.zh: 没错。因为交通中断，学校停课。是的。

subtitles.en: Just walk us through what we're seeing in Europe. Well, yeah, schools, you mentioned nurseries...
subtitles.zh: 给我们讲讲欧洲的情况。嗯，是的，学校，你提到了托儿所……

subtitles.en: Yeah, every parent in this building got a message the other day about nurseries being closed and schools being closed and every parent having to scramble to find something to do
subtitles.zh: 是的，这栋楼里每个家长前几天都收到消息说托儿所和学校关闭，每个家长都得赶紧想办法安置孩子。
en_highlights: scramble to find something to do

subtitles.en: with those kids. But yeah, a big heat wave gripping Western Europe right now.
subtitles.zh: 但没错，现在一场大热浪正席卷西欧。

subtitles.en: It's been particularly bad in France. They saw the hottest average temperatures across France for the whole day, anywhere.
subtitles.zh: 法国尤其严重。他们经历了法国全天平均气温最高的情况，任何地方都是。

subtitles.en: They've seen the hottest nights. You know, I don't know if you're like me.
subtitles.zh: 他们经历了最热的夜晚。我不知道你是否和我一样。

subtitles.en: I had a lot of trouble sleeping last night in London.
subtitles.zh: 昨晚在伦敦我很难入睡。

subtitles.en: Yeah, these are the so-called tropical nights where the temperature doesn't get below 20 degrees and people tired and sleepy,
subtitles.zh: 是的，这就是所谓的“热带夜”，气温不低于20度，人们感到疲倦和困乏。

subtitles.en: but it's also really the exhaustion from the heat during the day really starts to melt.
subtitles.zh: 但也是白天酷热带来的疲惫开始真正显现。

subtitles.en: And you were telling me the Eiffel Tower has been closed early in the Louvre as well?
subtitles.zh: 你刚才说埃菲尔铁塔和卢浮宫都提前关闭了？

subtitles.en: That's right. Both have been closed early in France and really some widespread disruption.
subtitles.zh: 没错，法国这两处都提前关闭了，确实造成了广泛影响。

subtitles.en: So it's really been a historic event in France.
subtitles.zh: 这在法国真是历史性的事件。

subtitles.en: This has been going on for a week now in France. They had this thing set in last week.
subtitles.zh: 法国这波热浪已经持续一周了，上周就开始了。

subtitles.en: And this is the second one that's hit France in just a couple months.
subtitles.zh: 这是短短几个月内法国遭遇的第二波热浪。
